title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view, edit, and run playbooks and access…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permissions to view, edit, and run playbooks and access at least one container label can retrieve a callback handle from a playbook run outside their container-label scope. This occurs because the system does not verify that the callback handle belongs to the parent playbook run that launched the child playbook. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 4.3, indicating medium severity.
